title: Add an account
intro: A new login on a host, for sessions to bill. Each login has its own name on that host, so one host can hold several accounts.

fields.name: profile
fields.label: Name
fields.help: Letters, digits, _ or -. New sessions pick the account by this name. On the host it lives in ~/.claude-profiles/<name>.

fields.name: setup_token
fields.label: Setup token
fields.secret_note: Run claude setup-token on any computer signed in to the subscription and paste the sk-ant-oat… it prints. Checked with Anthropic, then written to the host only. Fleet keeps no copy. It lasts a year; paste a new one here under the same name to replace it.

fields.name: account
fields.label: Same account as
fields.help: The subscription the token signs in to, when fleet already knows it from a login. Sessions then share that account's limits and usage.

fields.name: api_key
fields.label: API key
fields.secret_note: sk-ant-…, checked with Anthropic, then written to the host only. Fleet keeps no copy.

fields.name: daily_limit
fields.label: Daily limit (USD)
fields.help: Empty: no limit. Past it, no session starts on this account until midnight UTC.
